us.city: **Degree Days** and **Palmer Indices** are not available for **Cities**.
us.cityMappingRanks: Due to varying periods of record, **Ranks** are not provided for **Cities**.
us.statewideDivisional: **Degree Days** and **Palmer Indices** are not available for **Alaska** or **Hawaii**.
us.regional: **Degree Days** are not available for **Great Plains**, **Southern Plains and Gulf Coast**, **Rockies and Westward**, **River Basins**, or **Agricultural Belts**.
us.multiMonthPalmers: **Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI)**, **Palmer Hydrological Drought Index (PHDI)**, and **Palmer Modified Drought Index (PMDI)** are not offered for multiple-month time scales.

global.mapping: Global temperature departures are calculated using a 5°x5° grid, based on the **{{_GLOBAL_GRIDDED_BEGYEAR_}}-{{_GLOBAL_GRIDDED_ENDYEAR_}} average**. Global precipitation values use a 2.5°x2.5° grid and departures are relative to the **{{_GLOBAL_PCP_BEGYEAR_}}-{{_GLOBAL_PCP_ENDYEAR_}} average**. Please note, global precipitation data are processed on a different schedule and released separately from global temperature data.
global.default: Please note, gridded global temperature departures are with respect to the **{{_GLOBAL_GRIDDED_BEGYEAR_}}-{{_GLOBAL_GRIDDED_ENDYEAR_}} average**. All other temperature departures are with respect to the **{{_GLOBAL_GLOBE_BEGYEAR_}}-{{_GLOBAL_GLOBE_ENDYEAR_}} average**. Global precipitation data are processed on a different schedule and released separately from global temperature data.
